instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a modern indoor lounge with light wood paneling, a group gathers around a wooden coffee table. The man in the patterned blue polo (R2) leans forward from the left, placing his hand onto a central hand stack. The woman in the black top (R3) sits in the right foreground with her back to the camera, extending her hand to join. In the center background, the man in the green t-shirt (R1) sits on a blue sofa watching them, while the man in the red plaid shirt (R4) leans in from the right background. Warm indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the collaborative hand stack over the table.
elements: R2 leans forward and places his hand onto the central hand stack
R1 sits on the blue sofa watching rather than adding a hand to the stack
R3 sits in the foreground with her back to the camera and extends her hand to join the stack
R4 leans in from the background toward the group
the collaborative hand stack is over a wooden coffee table
the scene is a modern indoor lounge with light wood paneling
